title: "Step 3. Create the benchmark projects on WIMP"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

Each model run needs its own WIMP project, because the AI model and the detector
threshold are project settings. The WIMP API cannot create projects or change
these settings, so this is the one step done in the WIMP web interface. It takes
about two minutes per project.

## Settings for every benchmark project

| Setting | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Name | `Model benchmark testing: <classifier>, <detector setting>` | Matches `runs[].project_name` in the config |
| Sequence cutoff | **0 seconds** | Every image is its own sequence, so images are scored independently (Colin's method) |
| AI model / classifier | The model under test (e.g. Wet Tropics) | One model per project |
| Detector confidence threshold (TEST only, since 27 Oct 2026) | The value under test (0.25, 0.50, 0.75) | Leave at default on PROD |
| Automatic AI | On | The API also sets `automaticAi` on each deployment |
| Species tags | Created by the API from the class list | No manual tagging needed |

## AWT test set (November 2026)

| Run | Site | Detector threshold |
|---|---|---|
| prod_awt_default | wimp.wildobs.org.au | default |
| test_awt_md025 | wimp.test.wildobs.org.au | 0.25 |
| test_awt_md050 | wimp.test.wildobs.org.au | 0.50 |
| test_awt_md075 | wimp.test.wildobs.org.au | 0.75 |

After creating each project, copy its ID from the address bar
(`/project/<id>/...`) into `project_id` for that run in `config/awt_2026_11.yaml`.

## Check

```{python eval=FALSE}
!python -m wimpbench check --config config/awt_2026_11.yaml
```

`check` lists each run with the project name it found for that ID and stops if a
name does not match the config.
